newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Artfield buys lamp maker for HK$43 mln.
newsitem.headline: Artfield buys lamp maker for HK$43 mln.

text.p: Artfield Group Ltd said it had agreed to buy 95 percent of energy-saving lamp manufacturer and distributor Precision Group Ltd from its directors and an independent third party for HK$42.8 million.
The company said about HK$32.4 million of the purchase would be funded by internal resources and banking facilities.
The balance would be funded by issuing 4.15 million new shares, representing 1.78 percent of its enlarged share capital, at HK$2.50 per share.
Artfield shares were up HK$0.025 to HK$2.575 in late morning.
The clock maker said it would buy a 90 percent stake in Precision from directors Ip Yiu-tung, Ip Chun-keung, Yip Chi-wai and Ho Kwan-ching, and another five percent from third party Wu Ming-yuk.
Prior to the deal, Precision was 90 percent controlled by the four Artfield directors and 10 percent by Wu.
As part of the deal, Artfield said it would pay HK$2.5 million to the four directors to satisfy loans which they advanced to Precision.
The four directors hold about 62 percent of Artfield.
